description: Wrap a Helvetica block and give its height. Line breaking is the same as text-wrap. Leading defaults to 1.2 times the font size, rounded half away from zero to 0.001 pt. Block height is the line count times the leading, and a blank line from a hard break counts. An empty string has height zero. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/text-block

leading.description: Line height in points. Default is 1.2 × size
